en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Hasan b. Ibrahim b. Natana (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim narrated to us from his father from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from Abi Ziyad al-Nahdi from `Abdullah b. Bukayr. He said:
Al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) said: For a believer, it is enough of a victory from Allah to see his enemy disobeying Allah.
